gdp.note: US real GDP grew at an annualized rate of 1.5 percent in Q2 2026, the third estimate revised down from 1.8 percent in the prior quarter.

cpi.note: US CPI rose 3.1 percent year-over-year in August 2026, with shelter and energy the primary contributors, easing from 3.2 percent in July.

core_cpi.note: US Core CPI rose 3.4 percent year-over-year in August 2026, still above the Fed's 2 percent target, easing from 3.5 percent in July.

pce.note: US PCE price index rose 2.9 percent year-over-year in August 2026, the Fed's preferred inflation gauge, easing from 3.0 percent in July.

nonfarm_payrolls.note: US nonfarm payrolls added 142,000 jobs in August 2026, below the 12-month average of 185,000 and down from 145,000 in July.

unemployment_rate.note: US unemployment rate rose to 4.2 percent in August 2026, up from 4.1 percent in July, marking the second consecutive monthly increase.

ism_manufacturing.note: ISM manufacturing index registered 47.8 in September 2026, down 0.1 point from 47.9 in August, the fifth consecutive month below the 50 expansion threshold.

retail_sales.note: US retail sales rose 0.4 percent month-over-month in August 2026, beating expectations of 0.2 percent and up from 0.3 percent in July.

consumer_sentiment.note: University of Michigan consumer sentiment index rose to 68.5 in September 2026, up from 67.9 in August, the second consecutive monthly increase.

fed_balance_sheet.note: Federal Reserve balance sheet totaled $7.12 trillion as of the week ending September 30, 2026, down $18 billion from the prior week's $7.138 trillion, continuing the runoff.

reverse_repo.note: The New York Fed's overnight reverse repo facility totaled $412 billion on October 1, 2026, down $22 billion from the prior week's $434 billion, the lowest level since June 2021.

bis_cross_border_credit.note: Global cross-border credit grew 1.8 percent year-over-year in Q2 2026, slowing from 3.2 percent in Q1, indicating tighter international lending conditions.

uk_cpi.note: UK CPI rose 2.7 percent year-over-year in August 2026, easing from 2.9 percent in July but remaining above the Bank of England's 2 percent target.
